The '''Manglers''' were a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[gang]] who were lords of the Southern Underground on Coruscant . They were also one of the toughest gangs on Coruscant. It was rumored that even the [[Red Guard]] were hesitant to fight this gang.
